source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project. Native observations are separate from manual/mathematical expectations.
notes: 54 accepted complete native LCD/status key replays from exact PLUS. Saved directly to project.

Remainder with residual at most three decimal places displays quotient/remainder and stores E/F. Four-decimal residual falls back to ordinary division. Negative division also falls back and preserves E/F. E=2 and F=1123/1000 were read back independently.

Fraction display counts the reduced mixed form including separators, even in d/c output. 1+1/123456 fits ten cells and displays 123457/123456; 1+1/1234567 needs eleven and displays decimal. 12501/5000 is decimal because its mixed form needs eleven cells. The negative ten-cell case remains fractional.

Independent proper-fraction boundary: 1/12345678 is fractional, 1/123456789 is decimal. A long typed fraction 123456/185184 reduces to 2/3 and remains fractional; raw input digit count is not the PLUS result rule.

LineI preserves the long valid fraction and FORMAT cycles through decimal and back. Int(-3.7)=-3, Intg(-3.7)=-4. Rnd(123456.123456789) in Norm stores 123456.1235; (Ans-123456)*1e9=123500000 distinguishes stored rounding from presentation.
Manual fraction mixed-form budget is corroborated by native observations. These measured cases do not establish all mixed-fraction settings, nested functions or rounding limits.
